name: BTC signed aggressor flow
description: Each verified buyer-aggressed Coinbase or Kraken BTC/USD trade contributes positive price-times-size notional and positive base size; each seller-aggressed trade contributes negative values. Outputs sum those contributions over causal 1-, 10-, and 60-second receipt-time windows of (window close minus duration, window close]. Kraken subscription-snapshot rows are excluded. Ready output requires 60 seconds of uninterrupted observation and each venue demonstrably alive. A venue with no in-window trades but alive — any admitted input event from that venue within staleness_bound_ms — contributes truthful zeros (flow_direction_10s = "flat"); a venue with no admitted input within that bound keeps degrading as trade_venue_stale_or_missing. Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even.
